Weapons.Name: Flail of Broken Vows
Weapons.Description: A heavy iron flail wrapped in corroded sacred chains that grow heavier with the wielder's guilt.

Weapons.Name: Ethereal Soulblade
Weapons.Description: Twin daggers forged from spectral remnants that slice through physical armor directly into the enemy's soul.

Weapons.Name: Ashen Censer Mace
Weapons.Description: A hollow ceremonial mace emitting a constant mist of grey embers and funeral ash.

Weapons.Name: Sightless Stiletto
Weapons.Description: A long, needle-thin rapier without a guard, perfectly balanced for blind combatants relying on acoustic vibrations.

Weapons.Name: Greatsword of the Corrupted Commander
Weapons.Description: A rusted, notched zweihänder that echoes with the agonized screams of a fallen army.
